subject: general
question: At a certain sum of money with the interest rate of 6% per annum for 4 years. the simple interest is Rs. 4500. Find the compound interest (compounding annually) of 2 years at the same sum when the rate of interest is 4% per annum,
solution:
**Given:**

Rate₁ = 6%

Time₁ = 4 years

Simple Interest = Rs. 4500

Time₂ = 2 years

Rate₂ = 4%

**Concept Used:**

Simple Interest = PRT/100

Compound Interest = P(1 + R/100)T - P

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest = PRT/100

4500 = (P × 6 × 4)/100

P = (4500 × 100)/(6 × 4)

P = 750 × 25

P = Rs. 18750

Compound Interest = P(1 + R/100)T - P

Compound Interest = 18750(1 + 4/100)² - 18750

Compound Interest = 18750(26/25)2 - 18750

Compound Interest = 18750 × 676/625 - 18750 

Compound Interest = 20280 - 18750 

Compound Interest = 1530

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
